## Trigger

When a maintainer releases an already verified change, I want one prepared candidate to pass every required gate before tagging, so I can publish promptly without repeating manual preparation or testing different content.

## Demonstrated failure

The Codex policy removal passed a scratch release, but a later tutorial prose edit broke the positive control in test_docs_claims_tutorial during the main push. The local candidate was already tagged and was withheld. Preparing the replacement required full and fast verification in main and scratch, trial release, post-tag checks, tutorial replay, another whole suite and publication hooks. Separate mandatory steps repeatedly verified equivalent inputs while the person waited.

## Proposed outcome

Prepare and verify a single immutable candidate; automate tutorial claim updates; expose phase progress, elapsed time and evidence reuse; refuse content drift before creating a tag. Include all generated files in candidate equivalence, accounting explicitly for generation timestamps. Publish the tested bytes rather than allowing untested edits after the trial.

## Confirmation Plan

Measure the present release sequence and compare it with a release through the improved command in a disposable repository. Exercise successful publication preparation, a failed tutorial control, changed candidate content and a reused passing result. Retain every required gate and prove the failure cases create no tag. Record manual steps, check executions and elapsed time before and after.

payload.text: Investigation 2026-10-20: user identifies Codex on another machine and recalls PreToolUse and SessionStart. Both current repositories commit precisely these Codex hooks, unchanged since Lefthook migration 690669f4 (2026-10-14). Neither hook is disabled in this Linux user config; no hook state was present in the inspected Windows user config. No remote-machine logs are available. Isolated offline probe used git show HEAD for six committed files from each repository, git init in a temporary directory, and the exact POSIX command from hooks.json. Without the ignored .basicly/bin/lefthook, ordinary apply_patch, exec_command, and SessionStart each exited 2 with basicly hook failed: ValueError. Calling sync_binary in the scratch checkout made all three exit 0; a synthetic Generated by basicly file still exited 2 with the intended BLOCKED message. Fourteen probe assertions passed. launch checks the binary before dispatch can filter tools (lefthook-runtime.py:137-145, 97-99); main hides the actionable missing-runtime exception message (lines 218-220). SessionStart script itself always returns 0. Fresh-clone startup defect is established; attribution to the remote incident is plausible but unconfirmed. Missing uv or Python 3.14 remains an alternate remote-machine cause. Current official hook docs support exit 2 as a PreToolUse refusal: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/hooks . Recovery already exists: hooks-build --runtime-only restores only the packaged runtime (src/basicly/cli.py:2076-2081). No code or hook configuration changed.

payload.description:
## Trigger
When a fresh clone loads committed Codex hook definitions before its ignored Lefthook executable has been installed, I want startup to provide a working recovery path, so I can prepare the repository without disabling hooks.

## Steps to Reproduce
Load the committed hooks.json launcher in a fresh git checkout with the tracked runtime and shared configuration but no local binary. Invoke ordinary apply_patch, exec_command, and SessionStart payloads. All three exit 2 with only basicly hook failed: ValueError. Repeat after installing the packaged runtime: ordinary calls pass and generated-file protection still refuses generated edits.

## Scope
- `.basicly/core/hooks/lefthook-runtime.py`
- `src/basicly/codex_hooks.py`
- `tests/test_lefthook_migration.py`

Investigation basicly-vevvpef demonstrates the failure for both basicly and terminal. The launcher checks for its executable before filtering the tool; its exception handler suppresses the recovery instruction. Repair remains unimplemented and must retain intended generated-file protection.
payload.requirements: Preserve consumer hook configuration. Keep the runtime dependency local and portable. Add focused missing-runtime regression coverage.
